title: Claw Seed Schema
description: Production schema for a Claw seed — a machine-learnable behavior definition. Maps to P01: natural language purpose, trigger, learning strategy, default equipment. Enhanced from LOG-tensor conditional_geometry_schema (Ψ: (X, P, C) → (X', P', C')) with creative zone parameters and temperature schedule from P56/P57.

id.description: Unique identifier for this seed definition

purpose.description: Natural language description of the behavior this seed encodes. Used as seed prompt s in Ghost Tile triple GT = (M, s, h).

trigger.description: When this seed activates its agent

learningStrategy.description: How the seed's behavior is optimized on data

defaultEquipment.description: Equipment modules auto-equipped at agent spawn from this seed

creativeZone.description: P02/P56: Optimal Δ ranges for crystallization. κ(Δ) = exp(−(Δ−0.5)²/0.02) is maximized at Δ=0.5.

deltaMin.description: Lower bound of optimal crystallization zone

deltaMax.description: Upper bound of optimal crystallization zone

oneiricDeltaMin.description: Lower bound of oneiric (dream-mode) crystallization zone

oneiricDeltaMax.description: Upper bound of oneiric crystallization zone

kappaSigma.description: σ_c — width of the crystallization kernel κ(Δ) = exp(−(Δ−0.5)²/(2σ_c²))

temperatureSchedule.description: P56/P57: Temperature annealing schedule for crystallization/melt balance. DRM-1: T_idle rises monotonically.

idleMode.description: Temperature during idle/dream mode. Must be >= taskMode for DRM-1.

tauT.description: τ_T — time constant for T_idle rise after task completion (in seconds)

maxTemperature.description: Hard ceiling for temperature. Above this: overheating alert.

minTemperature.description: Hard floor for temperature. Below this: frozen agent alert

dreamConfiguration.description: P60: Configuration for oneiric creative zone behavior

maxDreamDuration.description: Maximum dream phase duration in seconds

wakeTrigger.description: What triggers exit from dream phase

constraints.description: P03: CSPersist constraints. Invariant constraints must hold across all agent states and molt transitions.

conservationMode.description: P56/P57: Conservation law mode. ONE_PHASE: η = (1−γ)². TWO_PHASE: tracks η explicitly. HYBRID: context-dependent.

maxDelta.description: Maximum allowed δ = 1−(γ+η). MUST be <= 0.25 per P57. Hard invariant.

moltThreshold.description: α — multiplier in melt pressure threshold: P_melt > α·κ(Δ)·(1−γ)·1/(1+βT)

origin.description: P03: Origin tracking — provenance of this seed definition

derivedFrom.description: Parent seed ID if this is a derivative

trigger.description: Activation trigger for the agent spawned from this seed

event.description: CNS event name or external trigger

properties.description: Trigger when |Δ − 0.5| exceeds threshold (creative zone exit)
Trigger when P_melt > max crystallization rate (molt trigger, P56)

learningStrategy.description: ML learning strategy for optimizing this seed

constraint.description: P03 CSPersist constraint. Invariant-level constraints must hold forever; range constraints validate on state change.

field.description: JSON pointer to field (e.g., '/state/gamma') or '/' for whole-agent constraint

expression.description: JavaScript expression evaluated in sandbox, or regex for regex-type. For conservation type: 'state.gamma + state.eta + state.delta <= 1 && state.delta <= 0.25'

recoveryAction.description: What to do when constraint is violated
